paragraphs: Flow Labs sells software that transportation agencies, engineering firms, and commercial fleets use to work on road safety and traffic flow. The company says the software requires no new hardware to be installed. Instead it takes real-time traffic data and turns it into insight meant to cut delays and prevent crashes.

The platform brings connected vehicle, infrastructure, freight, and safety data into one place. Its analytics measure intersection delay, systemwide travel time, emissions, and behavioral risk. Users can generate reports for corridors, intersections, before-after studies, or safety measures. One part of the system optimizes signal timing in real time to reduce delays and improve fuel efficiency. Another predicts crash risk, detects hazardous behavior, and recommends interventions.

The company announced that DDOT is expanding smart traffic signal monitoring across Washington, DC. That announcement says the expansion follows a pilot and reaches more than 1,600 signalized intersections citywide. An earlier announcement names Florida DOT District 5 and a real-time traffic management platform across 2,000 intersections.

quote.text: Integrate connected vehicle, infrastructure, freight, and safety data into one unified platform.
